the security incident was limited to just 19 accounts, all beta testers from april to june 2024, with no other users affected and no further movement of funds reported.

this makes the situation a lot more interesting than the initial speculation suggested.

if Ansem manages to recover and comes back swinging, the narrative could turn around very quickly.
